verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs show that multiple agent checkouts can each claim tasks and are tracked as separate rows under 'Development > Agents' ([foreloop-docs-8]), implying support for running several agents in parallel. However, there is no explicit feature for orchestrating, provisioning, or scaling many concurrent agents — each agent must be manually run in its own local checkout, so scaling relies on the user spinning up multiple environments rather than a built-in concurrency/queueing system.
